year, month, day, and hour are landed as DECIMAL(38,9) but every sample_value and distinct_value is integral (e.g. month 1.0-6.0, hour 0.0-23.0), so all four are cast to INTEGER.
time_hour samples are uniformly ISO-8601 with a Z suffix (e.g. 2013-01-01T06:00:00Z) and the operator confirms it is a UTC instant, so VARCHAR is cast to TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE.

purpose: This table holds cleaned hourly weather observations from the three NYC airport stations (EWR, JFK, LGA) for January through June 2013, sourced from ASOS via the Iowa Environmental Mesonet as packaged in nycflights13, feeding downstream joins against flight-level data on origin and time.
usage: Join on origin and time_hour to attach weather conditions to flights or other hourly events; wind_dir, wind_speed, wind_gust, and pressure may be null and must be filtered or coalesced deliberately before aggregation, since nulls represent missing source readings (NA) rather than zero values.
limitations: wind_gust is null in about 74.6% of rows and pressure is null in about 11.5% of rows, so any analysis relying on those fields loses substantial coverage; wind_dir and wind_speed carry small null rates (1.68% and 0.015% respectively) that are retained rather than imputed; the extreme DECIMAL(38,9) landed precision for all measurement columns was simplified to DOUBLE without rounding rules being validated against the original instrument precision.
